name: join
description: The join utility performs an 'equality join' on the specified files and writes the result to the standard output.

options.name: -a
options.description: In addition to the default output, produce a line for each unpairable line in file file_number

options.name: -e
options.description: Replace empty output fields with string

options.name: -o
options.description: The -o option specifies the fields that will be output from each file for each line with matching join fields.

options.name: -t
options.description: Use character char as a field delimiter for both input and output. Every occurrence of char in a line is significant

options.name: -v
options.description: Do not display the default output, but display a line for each unpairable line in file file_number. The options -v 1 and -v 2 may be specified at the same time
Join on the field'th field of file1
Join on the field'th field of file2

options.name: -j
options.description: Join on the field'th field of both file1 and file2

args.name: file1
args.description: First file in the join operation

args.name: file2
args.description: Second file in the join operation
